title: Hold a settlement agent's licence
what: Hold a settlement agent's licence, with a current triennial certificate, before carrying on business as a real estate or business settlement agent.

sources.title: Settlement Agents Act 1981 (WA)
sources.quote: On and after the appointed day a person shall not carry on business, or by any means hold himself or itself out, as a real estate settlement agent, or a business settlement agent, or both a real estate settlement agent and a business settlement agent, unless he or it is licensed as such under this Act and holds a current triennial certificate in respect of the licence.
